info.title: Isker API
info.description:
Isker assesses and develops entrepreneurial competencies (EntreComp, 15 competencies).

**Product loop:** Assess → Profile → Identify Gaps → Recommend → Learn → Practice → Re-assess → Track Progress.

**Authentication:** `POST /api/auth/login` sets an httpOnly session cookie (`isker_session`) and a readable CSRF
cookie (`isker_csrf`). Browsers must echo the CSRF cookie in an `X-CSRF-Token` header on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.
API clients may instead send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (no CSRF header needed).
Every token is bound to a server-side session that can be revoked.

**Authorization:** role-based (user, content_manager, support, admin, super_admin) with permission checks on the
server. **Entitlements:** plan features are enforced by the server; a missing entitlement returns
`403 UPGRADE_REQUIRED`.

**Errors** always use one envelope: `{"error": {"code": "ASSESSMENT_NOT_FOUND", "message": "...", "details": ...}}`.

put.description:
An unanswered question is edited in place. Once learners answered it, a content change creates a new version
(a new question id, `previous_id` → this one) used by new attempts, and this version is archived so completed
attempts keep their exact questions and scores.

AdminUserCreate.title: AdminUserCreate

lock_version.title: Lock Version

language.title: Language
language.description: Saved interface language (ru | kk | en); null = never chosen

auth_methods.title: Auth Methods
auth_methods.description: How the person can sign in: email = email + password set; google = Google linked. Hashes and OAuth subjects are never exposed.

expected_version.title: Expected Version

AnalysisRunIn.title: AnalysisRunIn
AnalysisRunIn.description: `regenerate`: write the existing analysis again (e.g. in the current interface language).

days.title: Days
days.description: Time-limited grant; omit for no end date

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Session token for API clients (Bearer). Browsers use the httpOnly cookie.

CharacterOut.title: CharacterOut
CharacterOut.description:
The learner's character stage. `stage` is the last confirmed stage (from the history); `score` and the progress
fields are the current value of the stage rule, so progress inside a stage shows before the next stage is
reached. Read-only: no request can set a stage.

CompetencyScoreOut.title: CompetencyScoreOut
CompetencyScoreOut.description: A competency in the user's current profile (latest measurement).

ContentStatus.title: ContentStatus
ContentStatus.description: Lifecycle of editable content. Only `published` content is visible on the learner platform.

window_days.title: Window Days
window_days.description: Rolling window of a limit (e.g. 30 days), so plan pages don't have to assume it.

QuestionOut.title: QuestionOut
QuestionOut.description: Question as shown to the learner. Never reveals which competency it measures (FR-14).

accept_terms.title: Accept Terms
accept_terms.description: Must be true: the user accepts the terms and the privacy notice
